evidence: Single-file main module (termpdf.py) with no package structure (packages=0, max_directory_depth=1)
Flat module with ~40+ top-level functions and a few classes (Config, Buffers, Screen, Document, etc.)
Heavy use of global state (e.g., Document subclasses, curses interaction, global config loading)
Dominant procedural logic flow: main() orchestrates the application with minimal separation of concerns
No explicit ports/adapters, layers, or modular boundaries; all functionality tightly coupled in one file
All core logic (PDF rendering, navigation, UI, external tools) embedded directly in class methods/functions without abstraction layers
risks: Low modularity makes testing, reuse, and maintenance difficult
High coupling increases risk of side effects when modifying any component
Scalability and extensibility are severely limited
Lack of separation of concerns violates core design principles for maintainable systems
